title: Cotechino with Lentils
summary: Italian tradition says lentils bring prosperity for the new year. The combination is rich and satisfying - a little cotechino goes far.

steps.text: Cook cotechino according to package instructions (typically simmer in water 20-30 minutes). Keep warm.
Heat olive oil in large pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrot, celery. Cook 8-10 minutes until very soft and golden.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add dried lentils (rinsed), bay leaves, and stock. Bring to boil.
Reduce to simmer, cook 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender but not mushy. Add water if too dry.
Season well with salt and pepper. Stir in parsley. Remove bay leaves.
Slice cotechino (125g per person). Serve over lentils, with polenta or mashed potatoes if desired.

tips: Standard cotechino is 500g (125g per person). Because it is extremely rich, this portion works well. The large soffritto base adds volume and flavour. The dish tastes better made ahead - flavours meld beautifully overnight.
